name: com.kareverse/kareverse
title: Kareverse
description: Elder care at home in Bangalore, India: services, prices, Care Plan, areas and callback requests.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search Kareverse's elder-care services in Bangalore by need (for example 'hospital visit', 'injection at home', 'night caretaker', 'physiotherapy after stroke'). Returns matching services with price, Care Plan member price and page URL. Leave query empty to list a category.

query.description: What the family needs, in plain words.

category.description: Optional category: genie (accompaniment and errands), nursing, caretakers, doctor-therapy, health-checks, condition-care.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Full details of one Kareverse service by id (from search_services): what is included and not included, price options, notice needed, FAQs and how to book.

tools.name: get_care_plan
tools.description: The monthly Kareverse Care Plan (a dedicated Care Manager, monthly home visit, weekly check-in, 24/7 emergency support): what it includes, monthly/quarterly/annual prices, and condition programmes such as dementia and Parkinson's care.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Check whether Kareverse covers a locality or pincode in Bangalore (e.g. 'Whitefield', 'HSR Layout', '560066'), or list all service areas when locality is empty.

locality.description: Locality, area or pincode in Bangalore.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Kareverse's published guides for families caring for elderly parents (costs, caretakers, dementia, falls, hospital discharge, NRI care, Karnataka schemes). Returns titles, summaries and URLs.

query.description: Topic, e.g. 'caretaker cost' or 'dementia at home'.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Kareverse's phone/WhatsApp, email, working hours and office address, plus the service categories.

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Record a callback request for the Kareverse team. The result contains a WhatsApp link the person must open and send to confirm; Kareverse only contacts people who confirm. First show the person Kareverse's privacy notice (https://www.kareverse.com/privacy) and say in one line where their details go (the Kareverse team's email, lead tracker and CRM, marked unconfirmed). Use only after they explicitly agree to be contacted and give their OWN name and phone number; set consent to true to confirm that. Never use it for someone else's number or for emergencies. May be temporarily unavailable.

name.description: Name of the person Kareverse should contact.

phone.description: Their phone or WhatsApp number, with country code (e.g. +91 98765 43210 or +1 415 555 0100).

service_interest.description: What they need, e.g. 'Care Plan', 'Hospital accompaniment', 'Night caretaker'.

parent_area.description: Where the parent lives in Bangalore.

message.description: Short background, in the person's words.

consent.description: True only if the person saw the privacy notice and agreed that Kareverse may contact them about this enquiry.
